name: creator_application_received
sent_when: They submit the creator sign-up form
body:
Hi {{1}}, thanks for applying to House of Collabs! 🎉

We've received your creator profile and our team is reviewing it now. We'll message you here as soon as there's an update.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name

name: creator_application_approved
body:
Hi {{1}}, welcome to House of Collabs! 🎉

Your creator profile has been approved. Log in to finish setting up your storefront so brands can discover and book you.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name

name: creator_application_rejected
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Admin's note (or "No reason was given.")
samples: Riya | Please add at least 3 recent videos.

name: profile_submitted
sent_when: They submit their profile for review
body:
Hi {{1}}, your House of Collabs profile has been submitted for review. ✅

We'll let you know here as soon as it's live.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name

name: profile_approved
body:
Hi {{1}}, your creator profile is now live on House of Collabs! 🎉

Brands can now discover your storefront and book your services.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name

name: profile_needs_changes
sent_when: An admin sends their profile back for changes
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Admin's note
samples: Riya | Please add a clearer profile photo.

name: profile_suspended
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Reason given by the admin

name: verification_submitted
body:
Hi {{1}}, we've received your verification details.

We're checking them now and will let you know shortly.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name

name: creator_verified
body:
Hi {{1}}, you're verified! ✅

Your verified badge is now showing on your House of Collabs storefront.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name

name: verification_not_approved
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Admin's note
samples: Riya | The name on the document does not match your profile.

name: verification_more_info
sent_when: An admin asks for more verification details
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Admin's note
samples: Riya | Please upload the back of your ID card as well.

name: order_new_creator
sent_when: A brand pays for one of their services
body:
Hi {{1}}, you have a new order! 🎉

*{{2}}* has ordered *{{3}}*. You'll earn *{{4}}* for this order.

Please accept it soon so the brand can get started.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Brand name | {{3}} Service title | {{4}} Creator's earning, formatted

name: brief_received_creator
sent_when: A brand sends them a campaign brief
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has sent you a new campaign brief: *{{3}}*.

Take a look and reply from your dashboard.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Brand name | {{3}} Brief title
samples: Riya | Glow Skincare | Diwali skincare launch

name: order_cancelled_creator
sent_when: The brand or an admin cancels their order
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Order number | {{3}} Reason (or "No reason was given.")
samples: Riya | HOC-10482 | The brand changed its campaign dates.

name: product_shipped_creator
sent_when: The brand ships the product for an order
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has shipped the product for order *{{3}}*. 📦

Please confirm on the order page once it arrives.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Brand name | {{3}} Order number

name: revision_requested_creator
sent_when: The brand asks for changes to a delivery
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has requested a revision on order *{{3}}*.

Open the order to see the changes they'd like.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Brand name | {{3}} Order number

name: delivery_approved_creator
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* approved your delivery for order *{{3}}*. ✅

Great work! We'll let you know as soon as the order is complete and your earnings are added.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Brand name | {{3}} Order number

name: order_completed_creator
body:
Hi {{1}}, order *{{2}}* is now complete. 🎉

*{{3}}* has been added to your House of Collabs earnings. You can withdraw it once it becomes available.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Order number | {{3}} Creator's earning, formatted

name: review_received_creator
body:
Hi {{1}}, you received a new *{{2}}-star* review on order *{{3}}*. ⭐

Open the order to read it.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Star rating (1–5) | {{3}} Order number

name: dispute_opened_creator
sent_when: The brand opens a dispute on their order
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has opened a dispute on order *{{3}}*.

Our team will review it and contact you. You can add details on the order page.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Brand name | {{3}} Order number

name: dispute_resolved_creator
sent_when: An admin resolves a dispute on their order
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Order number | {{3}} Admin's resolution note
samples: Riya | HOC-10482 | The delivery was accepted and payment released.

name: earnings_available
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* from your House of Collabs orders is now available to withdraw. 💰

You can request a withdrawal from your dashboard.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Amount, formatted

name: payout_requested
body:
Hi {{1}}, we've received your withdrawal request for *{{2}}*.

We'll message you as soon as it's been sent.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Amount, formatted

name: payout_sent
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Amount, formatted | {{3}} Bank / UTR reference

name: payout_failed
sent_when: A withdrawal is rejected or fails
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Amount, formatted | {{3}} Reason (or "Please check your payout details.")
samples: Riya | ₹12,000 | The bank account number is invalid.

name: brand_application_received
sent_when: They submit the brand sign-up form
body:
Hi {{1}}, thanks for signing up *{{2}}* on House of Collabs! 🎉

Our team is reviewing your brand details. We'll message you here as soon as your account is ready.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Brand name

name: brand_account_ready
sent_when: Their brand account is created or approved
body:
Hi {{1}}, your brand account for *{{2}}* is ready! 🎉

Log in to discover creators and place your first order.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Brand name

name: brand_application_rejected
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Brand name | {{3}} Admin's note (or "No reason was given.")
samples: Riya | Glow Skincare | We could not verify the brand website.

name: payment_received_brand
sent_when: Their payment for an order succeeds
body:
Hi {{1}}, we've received your payment of *{{2}}* for order *{{3}}*. ✅

*{{4}}* has been notified about your order, and we'll message you here as soon as they accept it.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Amount paid, formatted | {{3}} Order number | {{4}} Creator's name

name: payment_failed_brand
sent_when: Their payment for an order fails
body:
Hi {{1}}, your payment for order *{{2}}* didn't go through.

You can retry the payment from the order page.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Order number

name: order_expired_brand
body:
Hi {{1}}, order *{{2}}* has expired because the payment wasn't completed.

You can place a new order any time from the creator's storefront.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Order number

name: order_accepted_brand
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has accepted your order *{{3}}*. 🎉

We'll keep you updated as the work progresses.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Creator's name | {{3}} Order number

name: order_declined_brand
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Creator's name | {{3}} Order number | {{4}} Reason (or "No reason was given.")
samples: Riya | Riya Sharma | HOC-10482 | Not available on the requested dates.

name: order_cancelled_brand
sent_when: Their order is cancelled (by them or an admin)
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Order number | {{3}} Reason (or "No reason was given.")
samples: Riya | HOC-10482 | Cancelled at your request.

name: shipment_required_brand
sent_when: The creator is waiting for the product
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* is ready to start order *{{3}}* and is waiting for your product. 📦

Their shipping address is on the order page. Please ship the product and add the tracking details there.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Creator's name | {{3}} Order number

name: product_received_brand
sent_when: The creator confirms the product arrived
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has received your product for order *{{3}}*. ✅

They'll start creating your content next.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Creator's name | {{3}} Order number

name: work_started_brand
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has started working on your order *{{3}}*. 🎬

We'll let you know as soon as the content is delivered.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Creator's name | {{3}} Order number

name: content_delivered_brand
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has delivered your content for order *{{3}}*. 🎉

Please review it and approve, or request a revision.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Creator's name | {{3}} Order number

name: revision_submitted_brand
body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has submitted a revision for order *{{3}}*.

Please review the updated content and approve it, or request further changes.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Creator's name | {{3}} Order number

name: order_completed_brand
body:
Hi {{1}}, your order *{{2}}* with *{{3}}* is complete. ✅

Leave a review to help other brands find great creators.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Order number | {{3}} Creator's name

name: refund_processed_brand
sent_when: A refund for their order is processed
body:
Hi {{1}}, your refund for order *{{2}}* has been processed.

It usually takes 5–7 working days to reach your account, depending on your bank.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Order number

variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Creator's name | {{3}} Star rating (1–5) | {{4}} Order number

body:
Hi {{1}}, *{{2}}* has opened a dispute on order *{{3}}*.

variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Creator's name | {{3}} Order number

sent_when: An admin resolves a dispute on their order
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Order number | {{3}} Admin's resolution note

name: account_suspended
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name | {{2}} Reason (or "Contact support for details.")

body:
Hi {{1}}, good news — your House of Collabs account is active again. ✅

You can log in and pick up where you left off.
variables: {{1}} Recipient's first name
